sloka: शत्रुघ्नभवनं गत्वा ततो वाक्यमुवाच ह ।एह्यागच्छ रघुश्रेष्ठ राजा त्वां द्रष्टुमिच्छति ।। ७.४४.९ ॥
transliteration: śatrughnabhavanaṁ gatvā tato vākyamuvāca ha ।ehyāgaccha raghuśreṣṭha rājā tvāṁ draṣṭumicchati ।। 7.44.9 ॥

translations.english: The doorkeeper then went to Shatrughna's abode and spoke, saying, "Come, O best of Raghus, the king wishes to see you."
